title: Hydrodynamics-based gene transduction
protocol: Dilute plasmid DNA with sterile PBS right before injection.
Take 2 ml of the solution into a 3 ml syringe.
Attach a 27-gauge needle to the syringe.
Warm up a mouse using a Heatlamp for 1-2 minutes.
Fix the mouse in a Mouse Tail Illuminator.
Inject the DNA solution from the tail vein in 5-7 seconds.
Place the mouse back into the cage.
